title: Extra time and work allowances
intro: Allowances let learners ask for more time or more practice without staff stepping in each time. Each one has a unit, the places it covers, a total, and limits per request. They apply to new enrollments; learners already enrolled keep the allowances they started with.
empty: No extra allowances. Only the allowances the course itself declares are available.
name: Short name
name.hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; shown to staff only.
sharing.shared: One shared balance for all of them
sharing.per_scope: A separate balance for each one
sharing.shared.hint: Using it in one chapter leaves less for the others.
sharing.per_scope.hint: Every chapter or episode gets the full amount of its own.
maxPerGrant.tooLarge: Most per request cannot be more than the total.
summary: Up to {total} {unit, select, calendar_day {calendar days} planned_minute {planned minutes} episode {episodes} other {units}} for {place, select, course {the whole course} every_chapter {chapters} every_episode {episodes} other {these places}} ({sharing, select, shared {one shared balance} other {each with its own balance}}), at most {perGrant} per request and {grants} requests.
unusable.days: This allowance can never be used in {blocked} of its {places} places: they have no deadline to move. Choose places with a deadline, or add minutes or episodes instead.
unusable.work: This allowance can never be used in {blocked} of its {places} places: they have no work limit to raise. Choose places with a work limit, or use calendar days instead.
noPlaces: This allowance covers no place in the current course version (for example, the course explicitly turned extensions off there).
ultimate.hint: No extension, accommodation or exception can move the course past this date. Leave empty for no extra limit.
ultimate.value: No change can move the course past {date}.
